description: This file defines the LeaveModuleController class within the OrangeHRM Leave module. It extends a base controller and implements a handle method that directs to the leave module's default path.

classes.name: LeaveModuleController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling operations related to the leave module, specifically redirecting to the default leave page.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the request by retrieving the default leave module path and redirecting the response to that path.
